prior_period.note: Prior period is not fully inside the 2017-01..2018-08 full-coverage window, so no change is computed (RULE-22/25).

kpis.name: Delivered Merchandise Value (Revenue Proxy)
kpis.definition: Sum of item price of delivered orders by purchase date. Not accounting revenue or profit; freight excluded; refunds and accounting adjustments unavailable (D-016).

kpis.name: Freight billed
kpis.definition: Freight charged on items of delivered orders.

kpis.name: Average order value
kpis.definition: K01 / K03 for the same period.

kpis.name: Orders placed
kpis.definition: All orders created in the period, any status.

kpis.name: Cancellation rate
kpis.definition: Orders with status canceled / orders placed (RULE-26).

kpis.name: Unavailable order rate
kpis.definition: Orders with status unavailable / orders placed (RULE-26).

kpis.name: Active customers
kpis.definition: Distinct customer_unique_id with a delivered order.
